About our finance tools

Every finance calculator here runs entirely in your browser, so the salaries, balances and loan amounts you type are never uploaded. Live tools such as the currency converter and crypto tracker fetch public market data, but your inputs stay on your device.

Start with the compound interest calculator to see how monthly contributions add up over decades, use the loan & EMI calculator to compare repayment terms before you borrow, and check the currency converter before you travel or invoice abroad.

Frequently asked questions

Are these finance calculators accurate?

They use standard formulas: the amortization formula for loans, compound interest with your chosen compounding frequency, and live mid-market exchange rates. Results are estimates for planning and do not include fees or taxes unless a tool asks for them.

Do you store my financial data?

No. Calculations happen locally in your browser. Some tools remember your last inputs on your own device for convenience; you can clear them at any time by clearing site data.

Where do the exchange rates come from?

The currency tools use free public exchange-rate feeds, cache them for a short time and fall back to the most recent saved rates when you are offline.
